## Common WHERE Filters

### 分区/快照过滤

```sql
-- 取最新 start_date 快照
SELECT max(start_date) AS start_date
FROM dev_idecbi_fpna.ec_shopee_fpa_spl_cashback_dim__userlist_td
WHERE date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}') >= start_date

-- 取固定日期快照（早期版本）
WHERE start_date = date('2026-03-02')
```

### 实验标识过滤

```sql
-- 按单个 identifier 过滤（最常见）
WHERE identifier = 'Platform - DS Model User Group'

-- 按多个 identifier 过滤
WHERE identifier IN ('Platform - DS Model User Group', 'Program - Upsize Wed Test')

-- 按 identifier 组合条件过滤（Upsize Wednesday 与 DS Model 互斥）
WHERE (identifier = 'Platform - DS Model User Group'
       AND date('${...}') NOT IN (date('2026-03-25'), ...))
   OR (identifier = 'Program - Upsize Wed Test'
       AND date('${...}') IN (date('2026-03-25'), ...))
```

### 特殊过滤

```sql
-- 按星期过滤（仅手动任务使用）
WHERE day_of_week(start_date) = 2  -- 周二
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### 最新快照自连接（核心模式）

```sql
-- 取最新有效 start_date 然后 JOIN 回原表获取完整记录
WITH id_valid_date_11 AS (
    SELECT max(start_date) AS start_date
    FROM dev_idecbi_fpna.ec_shopee_fpa_spl_cashback_dim__userlist_td
    WHERE CAST('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}' AS DATE) >= start_date
      AND identifier IN ('Platform - DS Model User Group', 'Program - Upsize Wed Test')
)
SELECT user_id, group_name
FROM dev_idecbi_fpna.ec_shopee_fpa_spl_cashback_dim__userlist_td a
JOIN id_valid_date_11 b ON a.start_date = b.start_date
WHERE identifier = 'Platform - DS Model User Group'
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 按用户分组统计人数
SELECT start_date, identifier, group_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS num_user
FROM dev_idecbi_fpna.ec_shopee_fpa_spl_cashback_dim__userlist_td
WHERE start_date >= date('2026-02-28')
GROUP BY start_date, identifier, group_name

-- 按区域维度统计
SELECT start_date,
       'ID' AS grass_region,
       identifier,
       group_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_cnt
FROM dev_idecbi_fpna.ec_shopee_fpa_spl_cashback_dim__userlist_td
WHERE start_date >= date('2026-03-30')
GROUP BY start_date, identifier, group_name
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 取最新快照 + group_name 映射 (workflows/test)

```sql
WITH id_valid_date_11 AS (
    SELECT max(start_date) AS start_date
    FROM dev_idecbi_fpna.ec_shopee_fpa_spl_cashback_dim__userlist_td
    WHERE date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}') >= start_date
),
id_data_11 AS (
    SELECT
        date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}') AS grass_date,
        'ID' AS grass_region,
        CASE WHEN group_name IN ('Combo_Control', 'Combo_Local') THEN 'control'
             WHEN group_name IN ('Combo_MP', 'Combo_Ads', 'Combo_Reg') THEN 'mp_plus_ads'
        END AS group_name,
        user_id
    FROM dev_idecbi_fpna.ec_shopee_fpa_spl_cashback_dim__userlist_td a
    JOIN id_valid_date_11 b ON a.start_date = b.start_date
    WHERE (identifier = 'Platform - DS Model User Group'
           AND date('${...}') NOT IN (date('2026-03-25'), date('2026-04-01'), ...))
       OR (identifier = 'Program - Upsize Wed Test'
           AND date('${...}') IN (date('2026-03-25'), date('2026-04-01'), ...))
)
```

### Snippet 2: 固定快照 + 多 experiment 切换 (scheduled_tasks/th_and_id)

```sql
WITH id_data_1 AS (
    SELECT
        date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '+1d')}') AS grass_date,
        'ID' AS grass_region,
        CASE WHEN group_name IN ('Combo_Control', 'Combo_Local') THEN 'control'
             WHEN group_name IN ('Combo_MP', 'Combo_Ads') THEN 'mp_plus_ads'
        END AS group_name,
        user_id
    FROM dev_idecbi_fpna.ec_shopee_fpa_spl_cashback_dim__userlist_td
    WHERE start_date = date('2026-03-02')
      AND ((identifier = 'Platform - DS Model User Group'
            AND date('${...}') >= date('2026-03-05')
            AND date('${...}') <= date('2026-03-08'))
        OR (identifier = 'Special - Peakday Test'
            AND date('${...}') IN (date('2026-03-03'), date('2026-03-09'), date('2026-03-25')))
        OR (identifier = 'Program - Upsize Wed Test'
            AND date('${...}') IN (date('2026-03-04'))))
)
```

### Snippet 3: 手动统计实验组人数 (manual_tasks/check_rate)

```sql

    start_date,
    group_name,

    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS num_user
FROM dev_idecbi_fpna.ec_shopee_fpa_spl_cashback_dim__userlist_td

```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

### group_name 到实验组映射

```sql
-- 原始 group_name 到实验组 control/mp_plus_ads 的映射（出现在 10+ 个文件中）
CASE WHEN group_name IN ('Combo_Control', 'Combo_Local') THEN 'control'
     WHEN group_name IN ('Combo_MP', 'Combo_Ads', 'Combo_Reg') THEN 'mp_plus_ads'
END AS group_name
```

### identifier 驱动的实验选择逻辑

```sql
-- Upsize Wednesday 与 DS Model 互斥逻辑（出现在 5+ 个文件中）
-- DS Model 排除周三日期，Upsize 仅取周三日期
WHERE (identifier = 'Platform - DS Model User Group'
       AND target_date NOT IN (wednesday_dates))
   OR (identifier = 'Program - Upsize Wed Test'
       AND target_date IN (wednesday_dates))
```
